_comment: Each row of the capability matrix in the root CLAUDE.md, keyed by its first cell, names what would carry its reach on each surface (docs/specs/capability-matrix-check.spec.md). CLI: a command path, optionally with one option ('import transcript --samples'). MCP: a tool, or a tool input as tool.property[.property]. VS Code: a palette command (barwise.x) or a language-model tool or its input (barwise_x[.property]). A surface is reached when every name is registered; null is a surface where no single name would carry it, and the unnamed-registration rule covers it. 'unlisted' holds the registrations no row is about, each with its reason. check:capability-matrix holds this file and the matrix together.

vscode.barwise.newProject: scaffolds a .orm.yaml model; not the CLI's `project` command, which manages .orm-project.yaml (root CLAUDE.md, the name collision note)
vscode.barwise.highlightInDiagram: an editor helper on the open diagram, not a capability of the toolkit
vscode.barwise.copyElementName: an editor helper on the open diagram, not a capability of the toolkit
vscode.barwise.addToView: an editor helper for diagram views, not a capability of the toolkit
vscode.barwise.createView: an editor helper for diagram views, not a capability of the toolkit
vscode.barwise.loadView: registered for the diagram webview's own use and not contributed to the palette, so no user reaches it as a command
vscode.barwise.setAnthropicApiKey: stores the measurement-lane key in secret storage (docs/adr/keyless-model-access.md), not a modeling capability
vscode.chat:barwise.chatParticipant: the chat participant's slash commands; whether they count as VS Code reach is open decision 3 of capability-matrix-check.spec.md, and decision 3 of the ADR names only palette commands and language-model tools
vscode.mcp-provider:barwise.mcpServer: hands the bundled MCP server to the editor's chat, so MCP's column is reachable there too; open decision 3 of capability-matrix-check.spec.md, and decision 3 of the ADR does not count it
